_comment: LaunchAgents and long-running processes that make up the Edva always-on server (the kernel's). This installation's own services live in agent/local/services.json, merged by lib/registry.cjs.

services.name: claude-session
services.label: ai.claude.session
services.description: Launches process-manager which supervises chat-supervisor, ops-supervisor, wiki-server, and whatsapp-channel. KeepAlive=true. (Gmail-push ingress is a separate Cloudflare Tunnel under com.cloudflare.cloudflared.)

services.name: resilience-test
services.label: ai.claude.resilience-test
services.description: Scheduled kill-tests of the agent to verify recovery. StartCalendarInterval.

services.name: hum-sense
services.label: ai.claude.hum-sense
services.description: Situational trigger engine for hum. Runs the sensor registry (data/hum-sensors.json), drains pushed events, and gates dispatches to the hum agent. KeepAlive=true. If it dies, trigger-hum.sh's stale-heartbeat watchdog reverts hum to a plain 20-min cron tick. Inspect with `hum-sense status`.

services.name: process-manager-health
services.description: Process-manager HTTP health endpoint. Returns child process status.
